Scenario fixture: invalid-field-error-message

Each target has a stable id of the form ifem_case_NN.

A. Error message shown

01 — PASS: aria-errormessage names a shown message with text

Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

02 — PASS: aria-describedby gives the error, no aria-errormessage

Enter a postcode of 5 digits.

03 — PASS: error message is an icon with alt text

B. Error message hidden or empty (FAIL)

04 — FAIL: aria-errormessage names a hidden message (ERROR_MESSAGE_HIDDEN)

Enter an email address.

05 — FAIL: aria-errormessage names a message hidden with display:none (ERROR_MESSAGE_HIDDEN)

Enter a phone number.

06 — FAIL: aria-errormessage names an empty message (ERROR_MESSAGE_EMPTY)

C. Cannot tell (CANTTELL)

07 — CANTTELL: no aria-errormessage or aria-describedby (NO_ERROR_MESSAGE)

Age must be a number.

08 — CANTTELL: aria-errormessage names no element (ERROR_MESSAGE_TARGET_MISSING)
09 — CANTTELL: hidden aria-errormessage, but aria-describedby gives a description (ERROR_MESSAGE_NOT_SHOWN_DESCRIBED)

Enter a date.

Date must be in the future.

D. Left out (no occurrence)

10 — NEUTRAL: aria-invalid="false"

Enter an email address.

11 — NEUTRAL: aria-invalid="spelling" marks text, not an entered value
12 — NEUTRAL: a disabled field
13 — NEUTRAL: a hidden field
14 — PASS: the message box is visibility: hidden, but its text is brought back with visibility: visible
Enter a valid email address.
15 — CANTTELL: the message is shown, but aria-hidden keeps its text from assistive technology
